question: A user asks to run DEFT for Cosmos Reason ITS binary video questions. Identify the applicable skill and outline its workflow without executing anything.
ground_truth: Identify tao-run-deft-cr-its and describe baseline evaluation, BCQ gap analysis, selected mining/GenAI data construction, annotation assembly, training, evaluation, and iteration.
expected_behavior: Identifies tao-run-deft-cr-its
Explains that data_generation.mode selects mining, genai, or both
Outlines the iterative evaluation and training workflow
Does not execute commands

question: Explain which annotations train iteration 1 for each tao-run-deft-cr-its data generation mode. Do not execute commands.
ground_truth: Mining uses mined annotations only; GenAI uses generated annotations plus an optional initial train dataset; both uses mined and generated annotations and never directly includes the original mining source dataset.
expected_behavior: Distinguishes mining, genai, and both
Seeds only GenAI-only mode from the optional initial training dataset
Excludes raw source annotations from both mode
Explains later-iteration accumulation

question: A GenAI-enabled tao-run-deft-cr-its run has no working captioning endpoint. Explain what the agent should do without executing commands.
ground_truth: The user must provide an externally managed VLM captioning base URL. Verify it before baseline evaluation, stop on failure, and do not start vLLM.
expected_behavior: Requires a user-provided captioning endpoint
Verifies it before workloads
Does not launch vLLM
Stops and reports endpoint failure

question: A tao-run-deft-cr-its run was interrupted after several stages. Explain how the agent determines the next stage without rerunning iteration 1. Do not execute commands.
ground_truth: Use the initialized run directory and resume_position.py. The append-only loop log drives the refreshed state and the configured data-generation mode determines which stages are expected.
expected_behavior: Uses the existing initialized run directory
Names resume_position.py as the next-stage authority
Uses loop_log.jsonl and the configured mode
Does not restart iteration 1 by default

question: Explain how the GenAI branch handles two failed KPI questions sharing one video. Do not execute commands.
ground_truth: Each media/question pair gets a stable gap id, PAIDF generates once for the shared media path, and its handoff expands back to both ids so both questions can become LLaVA records.
expected_behavior: Keeps both question rows
Deduplicates PAIDF generation by media path
Expands the handoff back to every gap id
Does not collapse distinct questions
